title: Missing Content-Security-Policy
evidence: HTTP HEAD / returned 200; content-security-policy header absent.
impact: Absent CSP may reduce mitigation against injected active content.
limitations: Missing header alone does not establish exploitation; review actual endpoint and browser context.

title: TLS certificate trust or identity validation failed
description: TLS certificate trust or identity validation failed
evidence: [SSL: CERTIFICATE_VERIFY_FAILED] certificate verify failed: self-signed certificate (_ssl.c:1029)
impact: Clients cannot establish authenticated server identity.
remediation: Install a valid certificate chain whose SAN matches the assessed address; lab self-signed certificates are expected exceptions.
limitations: Verification can also fail due to missing local CA trust or lab-issued certificates.

title: No observed clickjacking framing restriction
evidence: Neither CSP frame-ancestors nor valid X-Frame-Options present in HTML response.
impact: The page could permit undesired framing.
remediation: Set CSP frame-ancestors or X-Frame-Options after checking intended embeds.
limitations: Only sampled the root HEAD response; exploitability depends on page behavior.

title: Missing X-Content-Type-Options
evidence: HTTP HEAD / returned 200; x-content-type-options header absent.
limitations: Missing header alone does not establish exploitation; review actual endpoint and browser context.

title: Server header disclosed
impact: Discloses a server identifier that may assist reconnaissance.
remediation: Review whether a detailed Server header is necessary; patching matters more than hiding it.
limitations: Server banner may be inaccurate; no version-specific vulnerability has been verified.
